evidence: TMA, vaporized at 5°C, and NH3, with a flow rate of 300 standard cubic centimeters per min (sccm), were used as Al precursor and reactant, respectively. TMA and NH3 were sequentially injected with a purge step intervening between them using Ar (600 sccm) as purge gas. The purge durations for TMA and NH were 8 and 30 s, respectively.
